statement:
Urban Hearth is a Michelin-recommended, woman-owned restaurant in Inman Square, Cambridge. We cook to taste like New England: its seasons, its farms, its coast. Our cuisine is built around close relationships with local farmers, fishermen, and foragers, and the belief that every dish carries a story of seasons, farmers, memory, and place.

Chef-owner Erin Miller opened Urban Hearth in 2016 as a 24-seat restaurant in North Cambridge. In June 2026 it moved to a much larger space at 1281 Cambridge Street, in Inman Square.

We approach fine dining as an act of generosity rather than exclusivity, and we offer two ways in. The 32-seat dining room is à la carte shared plates, and walk-ins are welcome. The six-seat Chef's Counter is the other half: our chef cooks and plates every course and talks you through each one. One is an open door, the other is a chef cooking for you personally, and both come from the same idea.

The restaurant is built around the people who make it possible: the farmers, fishermen, and foragers we source from; the kitchen team who compose each plate; the dining room team who create the experience; and the guests who come back season after season.
farmsIntro: Our menu is shaped by the people who grow and raise the food. These are the farms and producers we work with most closely.
